title: Square of a threshold derivative summand
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p$ be a real-valued function on $\{-1,1\}^n$, and choose a coordinate $i$ and an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The square of the product of the $i$th input sign and the real-valued threshold of the $i$th discrete derivative of $p$ at $x$ is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
